sentences.text: This is the First application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant is apprehends her arrest in connection with Crime No.239/2022 registered at Police Station-Bahodapur, District-Gwalior (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 376,
376(2)(N), 376 D, 370, 109 read with Section 34 & 506 of IPC.

As per the prosecution case on 19.04.2022 at 6.25 P.M. prosecutrix aged about 20 years lodged a computerized complaint with P.S. Bahodapur against accused Raju @ Rashid alleging that accused Raju @ Rashid in the pretext of marriage on 15.10.2020 at 10 A.M. took her and kept her in his house.
In the pretext of marriage regularly committed sexual intercourse with her but never solemnized marriage.
Afterwards he had detained in jail.
Afterwards, she gave a birth to a child.
When he came back from prison, she requested for solemnizing marriage, he refused and threatened her to dare consequences and threw away her from his house.

She was scared due to which she could Beby Shah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116800081/

sentences.text: Afterwards, she narrated the incident to her mother.
Thereafter, on her report aforesaid offence was registered.
She was sent for medical examination.
During investigation, her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. has been recorded.
She has stated that mother of the accused Beby Shah, present applicant/accused apprehends her to indulge in sexual activities with another person.
Accused Raju was already married and he was having two children.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent.
She is aged about 56 years.
She has been falsely implicated in the case.
Therefore, prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and considered the arguments advanced by them and perused the record.

Looking the facts and circumstances of the case without commenting on merits of the case, by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash surety of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) the application is allowed.

It is also directed that in the event of arrest, applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs.
twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.
The applicant shall cooperate in the trial and shall apply regular application before the trial Court as and when required.
She shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C. In case of default
, the cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall stand forfeited automatically.
With the aforesaid directions, the present application stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE mani SUBASRI MANI 2023.01.19 18:24:32 -08'00'
